## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `status` helper should be fixed so its revision identifier and its docstring agree: the docstring promises the same identifier as `history`, but the code prints a shorter one, and the added test accepts either length.

## Changes
The pull request adds `status(revision, attempt)` and `attempt_label(attempt)` to `app/display.py`, plus an unused module-level string constant. It also adds two tests covering the attempt label and the prefix and suffix of the status line.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:13 — comments — Reconcile status revision length with its docstring — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status` prints `Running: 0123456` while `history` prints `History: 0123456789ab`. The docstring says "Show the deployment revision using the same identifier as history", but line 14 has `short_revision = revision[:7]` where `history` at line 5 uses `revision[:12]`. — Operators cannot match a running deployment's status line to its history or completion line by exact identifier, and the docstring misstates the contract. — Fix: Either slice `revision[:12]` as `app/display.py:5` does, or reword the docstring if the 7-character form is intended; in both cases extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to assert the revision, because it currently passes for any slice length.
